title: Aspect Ratio Calculator
description: Reduce any width × height to its simplest aspect ratio, or find the missing side from a ratio.
howto: Enter any width and height to get the simplified ratio (e.g. 1920×1080 → 16:9).
Or enter a ratio plus one known side to compute the missing side.
Both results update live as you type.

faqs.a: Both numbers are divided by their greatest common divisor. 1920 and 1080 share a GCD of 120, giving 16:9.

faqs.q: What is the decimal value for?
faqs.a: Width ÷ height, useful for comparing ratios: 16:9 = 1.78, 4:3 = 1.33, 21:9 = 2.33.

faqs.q: Can I use this for print sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter the print dimensions in any unit and the ratio is unit-independent.
